judge_notes.opus5: The licensing program has run far ahead of the company's own 'not until 2027' guidance — four licensees, two September guidance raises, and USITC institution of 337-TA-1526 against nine respondents on 9 October — yet the stock trades below its pre-first-license level of ~$216 (i2), so the market is valuing it at zero; the EPS bar of $1.27-1.32 looks under-carried against ~$28m of near-100%-margin royalty (i0), the 36% drawdown has no company-specific cause and the skew is call-bid at -5.5. The Q4 royalty-durability risk (i1) is real and is what sold the last print, so the uncertainty sits in p_up, not in the 18% scale.
judge_notes.opus55: Licensing ahead of guide with a new ITC case and a -36% sector-driven drawdown below the pre-license price with calls bid (i2, i3), plus royalty-margin EPS upside (i0), against Q4 royalty-durability risk (i1); scale from the 16.6% median reaction.
judge_notes.sonnet55: Revenue is pre-announced, but the royalty margin likely lifts EPS above $1.27-1.32 and the stock is -36% in 3 weeks on sector de-risking with no company negative; the durability of the Q3 royalty in the Q4 guide is the offsetting risk on a name that moves 16% a print.
judge_notes.fable51: Near-100%-margin royalty on pre-announced revenue makes an EPS beat likely against a $1.27-1.32 bar, four licensees and a new ITC case arrived after management said licenses might wait until 2027, and the stock trades below its pre-license level after a 36% sector-driven drawdown; a Q4 guide that normalises royalty against a flat Q4 EPS consensus is the large offsetting risk on a 16%-median mover.
